phaseName: Multi-workspace isolation, membership RBAC and authorized scopes
statusDetail: Workspace isolation, membership RBAC, authorized-scope lifecycle and deterministic scope validation are implemented and verified on SQLite through automated tests and a live Kestrel run. PostgreSQL migrations were generated but never executed because no server is available; that verification is BLOCKED. No Phase 3 scanning or connection code exists.

git.commitSubject: feat(phase-2): add workspace isolation, membership RBAC and authorized scopes
git.reportCommit: the commit that adds this report; see git log for docs/reports/phase-2-workspaces.md

implemented: Workspace, WorkspaceMembership and WorkspaceRole domain model with permission table
Explicit server-side access resolver on every workspace and scope operation
Owner/Administrator/Analyst least-privilege model with global-role independence
Last-owner protection inside the mutation transaction
Scope registration always Pending; explicit audited approval with required evidence
Revocation, expiration and restriction-edit lifecycle rules
Deterministic validation policy with DNS resolution, per-address approval and pinned addresses
Private/reserved network gating via deployment switch plus scope restriction
Redirect containment by scheme, host and port with independent re-evaluation
Workspace, membership and scope HTTP endpoints
EF Core migrations for SQLite and PostgreSQL
Global audit records plus append-only per-scope audit history
notImplemented: Asset discovery, scanning, Nmap integration and any network connection
Findings, attack graphs, AI adapters and reporting

Owner: add/remove members and change roles, including owners
register, approve, revoke, expire scopes and update restrictions
Administrator: add/remove non-owner members and change non-owner roles
register, approve, revoke, expire scopes and update restrictions

steps.detail: Kestrel started against a fresh SQLite database

passed: Non-member cannot read, update, list members or list scopes of a workspace (404)
Member of another workspace cannot read a scope by id (404)
Analyst cannot update, archive, add members or approve scopes (403)
Administrator cannot archive, grant Owner, modify Owner or remove Owner (403)
Last Owner cannot be demoted or removed (409)
Archived workspace rejects update, member changes and scope registration (409)
Registration always leaves a scope Pending and unusable
Approval without evidence returns 400; Analyst approval returns 403
Approval past the stored deadline is denied even if the expire endpoint was not called
Restriction change resets approval to Pending and clears evidence
Hostname approval does not authorize a resolved address (ResolvedAddressNotApproved)
DNS rebinding to an unapproved address is denied with no pinned address
Private address is denied by default and denied without the scope restriction even when the switch is on
Redirect changing scheme, host or port is denied (RedirectOutsideScope)
Userinfo, path, query, fragment, /0 CIDR, IPv4-mapped IPv6, zone index and single-label hostnames are rejected
Workspace audit actions (created, member added, role changed, member removed, archived) are present and contain no password-like data
notVerified: Connection-time pinning (no Phase 3 connection code exists)

artifacts.meaning: SQL emitted from the SQLite migrations; applied on a fresh database
SQL emitted from the PostgreSQL migrations; never executed on a server

artifactHashNote: SHA-256 values are computed over the committed Git blobs (git cat-file blob HEAD:<path>) so they reproduce from a fresh checkout. Byte lengths are the committed lengths.
limitations: PostgreSQL migrations are generated but never applied; runtime verification is BLOCKED
Pinned addresses are returned by policy only; Phase 3 scanners must enforce connection-time pinning
DNS is resolved once per evaluation; callers must honour the returned pins
Workspace isolation is application-level; no database row-level security
Failed audit writes are logged but do not roll back the action
No MFA, password reset or email verification
CI has never executed because no remote is configured
No workspace deletion or ownership-transfer endpoint
No frontend, assets, findings, graphs, AI or reporting
